slides.title: Quiet with some. *Loud* with others.
slides.sub: A small map of how you show up.

slides.title: Make two lists
slides.body: People you go quiet around. People you get loud around. Loud can mean arguing, joking harder, or talking over.

slides.title: Look for the thread
slides.body: What do the quiet names share? The loud ones? Maybe it's who you want approval from, or who you expect to push back.

slides.title: Ask what it protects
slides.body: Going quiet might keep the peace. Getting loud might keep you from feeling small. Neither is wrong. Both are worth seeing.

slides.title: Pick one name
slides.body: Next time you're with them, notice the moment your volume changes. What were you feeling right before it?
